Same script here. But tested a little more and I was able to reproduce the exact steps. For example, this works correctly:

1. Create a new sprite
2. Close it

But the following generates this extra ERR before site change event:

1. Create a new sprite
2. *Close the Home tab*
3. Close the sprite

And if you keep the Home tab closed, just creating a new sprite and closing it as in the first example, will start printing the ERR line.

issue_context.title: Debug beforesitechange event
issue_context.body:
Related to #4569 and #4780, I've created a little extension to test if the `beforesitechange` is generated correctly: [dacap-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18338345/dacap-test.zip) (*fixed version*)

At least two main issues I've found so far inside the `beforesitechange` handler:

1. `app.image` doesn't have the active image (it is just `nil`), not sure if it's easy enough to make this work
2. when a new sprite (File > New) is created, `beforesitechange`/`sitechange` events are generated with the old sprite, and both events are generated again with the new sprite, instead of a `beforesitechange` with the old sprite, and `sitechange` with the new sprite.

Here a little video of the extension installed:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b3edef1e-1ffc-464d-b249-a11bdc6a175d

Anyway the most important case that should work (I'll test this later) is that before closing a sprite, we should receive a `beforesitechange` and be able to access the sprite preferences ([app.preferences.sprite(app.sprite)](https://www.aseprite.org/api/app_preferences#apppreferencesdocument)) that is going to be closed.
comments:
> Anyway the most important case that should work (I'll test this later) is that before closing a sprite, we should receive a `beforesitechange` and be able to access the sprite preferences ([app.preferences.sprite(app.sprite)](https://www.aseprite.org/api/app_preferences#apppreferencesdocument)) that is going to be closed.

Is the event received when the instance of Aseprite itself is closed as well? I assume the active sprite's "onClose routine" is called when it happens, but I just wanted to make sure haha

@MapleGecko at the moment the event is disabled, wasn't included in the beta as it wasn't working as expected. I think the general idea is to receive a beforesitechange in any case the sprite is going to be deselected (even in the close event of the sprite or the app). But this is still a work in progress.
The current implementation will not generate a `beforesitechange` when the image is changed (this is already true for `sitechange`, that event is not generated when we draw the active image/cel).
